name: JACCS Co., Ltd.
summary: JACCS Co., Ltd. operates as a consumer finance company in Japan and internationally. The company provides installment credit and other settlement methods for automobiles, home renovation, solar systems, dental, and education. It also issues credit cards and prepaid cards; and offers rental guarantee, bill collection, reimbursement, personal and housing loan guarantees, non-life and life insurance agency, leasing, automatic, and claim management and collection services. The company was formerly known as Depart Sinyohanbai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JACCS Co., Ltd. in April 1976. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
